import re

BAD = """FROM node:latest
WORKDIR /app
RUN apt-get update
RUN apt-get install -y curl git
ADD ./app.tar.gz /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
"""

GOOD = """FROM node:22.11-bookworm AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

FROM node:22.11-bookworm-slim AS runtime
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:3000/healthz || exit 1
CMD ["node", "dist/server.js"]
"""

DEPS_RE = re.compile(r"\b(npm ci|npm install|pip install|go mod download|apt-get install|apt install)\b")
APT_UPDATE_RE = re.compile(r"\bapt-get update\b|\bapt update\b")


def split_stages(text):
    stages, cur = [], None
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        s = raw.strip()
        if not s or s.startswith("#"):
            continue
        cmd, _, rest = s.partition(" ")
        cmd, rest = cmd.upper(), rest.strip()
        if cmd == "FROM":
            parts = rest.split()
            alias = parts[2] if len(parts) >= 3 and parts[1].lower() == "as" else None
            cur = {"image": parts[0], "alias": alias, "instrs": []}
            stages.append(cur)
        elif cur is not None:
            cur["instrs"].append((cmd, rest))
    return stages


def base_tag_problem(image):
    if "@sha256:" in image:
        return None
    if ":" not in image:
        return "untagged"
    return "latest" if image.rsplit(":", 1)[1] == "latest" else None


def lint(text, has_dockerignore):
    stages = split_stages(text)
    issues = []
    if not has_dockerignore:
        issues.append("no_dockerignore")
    for st in stages:
        tag = base_tag_problem(st["image"])
        if tag:
            issues.append("base_image_%s:%s" % (tag, st["image"]))
    # apt-get update 与 install 必须同一 RUN
    runs = [arg for st in stages for cmd, arg in st["instrs"] if cmd == "RUN"]
    if any(APT_UPDATE_RE.search(r) for r in runs) and any(DEPS_RE.search(r) for r in runs):
        same = [r for r in runs if APT_UPDATE_RE.search(r) and DEPS_RE.search(r)]
        if not same:
            issues.append("apt_get_update_split_across_runs")
    if any(cmd == "ADD" for st in stages for cmd, _ in st["instrs"]):
        issues.append("add_instruction_used")
    if len(stages) >= 2:
        joined = " ".join(a for st in stages for _, a in st["instrs"])
        if "--from=" not in joined:
            issues.append("multi_stage_without_from")
    else:
        issues.append("single_stage_build")
    # COPY . . 是否早于依赖安装（破坏缓存）
    for st in stages:
        seen_copy_all = False
        for cmd, arg in st["instrs"]:
            if cmd == "COPY" and arg.replace(" ", "") in (". .".replace(" ", ""), ".."):
                seen_copy_all = True
            elif cmd == "COPY" and arg.strip() == ". .":
                seen_copy_all = True
            elif cmd == "RUN" and DEPS_RE.search(arg) and seen_copy_all:
                issues.append("copy_all_before_deps_install")
                break
    final = stages[-1]
    user = [a for cmd, a in final["instrs"] if cmd == "USER"]
    if not user or user[-1].strip() in ("root", "0"):
        issues.append("final_stage_runs_as_root")
    if not any(cmd == "HEALTHCHECK" for st in stages for cmd, _ in st["instrs"]):
        issues.append("no_healthcheck")
    return stages, sorted(set(issues))


for label, text, ign in (("bad", BAD, False), ("good", GOOD, True)):
    stages, issues = lint(text, ign)
    print("=== Dockerfile(%s) ===" % label)
    print("stages=%d final_image=%s" % (len(stages), stages[-1]["image"]))
    print("issues=%d" % len(issues))
    for i in issues:
        print("  - " + i)
    print("valid=%s" % (len(issues) == 0))
